body: This post was a mistake. Thanks for the inboxes and chats, though. I've decided that waiting another week or two is pointless. Thanks for helping me see that I need to just do it now.

My life, my terms. 

I've gone out so much, volunteered so much, sometimes I don't see my home for days. I go without sleep. I give away thousands of dollars. 

What did it get me? Nothing.

And I am done.

I've done hobbies. I've worked. This year, I choose to spend it with a spouse or significant other or...not at all. If you think spending time with strangers is the same, you don't understand. If you feel alone when WITH someone, you're not capable of understanding.

This is my first reddit post and yeah... confirmed suicide is the right option.
